'''Lergan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenary and a non-Force sensitive member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Lergan fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, the group of mercenaries Lergan was with was attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

Lergan, along with [[Hansh]], was killed by [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] after attempting to flee from Darth Bane.
